title: Tell us what helped and what felt confusing
subtitle: Share onboarding friction, listing confusion, offer flow issues, or ideas that would make the first-time experience easier for new traders.
callout: This feedback form is for product and onboarding improvements. If you need to report abuse, scams, or unsafe behavior, use the reporting tools on the relevant listing, offer, message, review, or profile instead.

context.title: Add useful context
context.description: Mention what you were trying to do, where you got stuck, and what you expected to happen next.

reporting.title: Separate from abuse reporting
reporting.description: Beta feedback goes to the product team. Safety or moderation issues should still be reported through the dedicated reporting flow.

fields.messagePlaceholder: Example: I understood how to create a listing, but I was not sure whether I should save a draft first or publish it immediately...

helper: Be specific when possible. Mention the page or flow, what felt unclear, and what would have made the experience easier.

success.toast: Thanks! Your beta feedback was submitted.
success.title: Thanks for helping improve the beta
success.description: Your feedback has been recorded for the product team. Keep exploring and send another note whenever you notice friction in the onboarding journey.

error.toast: We could not submit your beta feedback right now. Please try again.

validation.messageMin: Add at least 20 characters so the team has enough context.
validation.messageMax: Feedback must be 2000 characters or fewer.

admin.title: Beta feedback inbox
admin.description: Review beta-submitted product feedback, keep track of triage status, and resolve onboarding friction reported by testers.
admin.inboxDescription: {{count}} feedback item matched the current inbox filters.
admin.inboxDescription_plural: {{count}} feedback items matched the current inbox filters.
admin.loadErrorDescription: The server could not return the beta feedback inbox. Try again or adjust the current filter.
admin.emptyFilteredDescription: Try broadening the inbox filter or clearing the current status selection.
admin.emptyDescription: Submitted beta feedback will appear here once testers start sharing product notes.
